fields.notes: TFP410 production characterization relies on parametric ATE + lab-bench TMDS eye / timing measurements against DVI Compliance Test Specification. Useful in-band test bits are RSEN / HTPLG / MDI / H_RES / V_RES / CFG / REV_ID. JTAG and standard scan are not documented in the public datasheet.
internal_diagnostics: VEN_ID / DEV_ID / REV_ID — silicon presence via I2C.
RSEN — receiver presence on DC-coupled link.
MDI — interrupt flag on RSEN or HTPLG change.
TDIS — TMDS mute while PLL stays locked.
VEN / HEN — gate VSYNC / HSYNC transmission.

scan_topology.vendor_BIST_extensions: TFP410 does NOT expose loopback/PRBS/eye-monitor modes via I2C registers.
